item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 29/Aug/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring very hot weather to southern China today. With the weakening of the anticyclone aloft, showers will increase over the region in the middle and latter parts of this week. A weak northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week.

Date/Month: 29/08 (Monday)
Wind: East to southeast force 2 to 3.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers and isolated thunderstorms. Very hot with sunny intervals in the afternoon.
Temp range: 28 - 33 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
